notes: The report opens «وَ سَأَلَ» with no transmitter, so the asker «سليمان بن جعفر الجعفري» is not a link (rule 5); the Imam who answers is the one link named in the words; «أبا جعفر» is quoted inside the answer («كان يقول»), and it is unclear whether he is a transmitter or only the saying's author, so he is not added (rule 6); the previous report's chain is not taken over because the text does not open with «عنه» or «بهذا الإسناد»
